scope: Two distinct historical experiments. Do not pool or substitute their metrics. Not clinical validation or a new execution.

studies.title: Cardiac-adapted comparator experiment
studies.provenance: Complete five-line CSV read from original Library file. Backing-file bytes could not be materialized, so no source SHA256 asserted.
studies.aggregation: Unspecified in source CSV, do not label macro or pooled
studies.takeaway: The cardiac-adapted method reports higher F1 than EWMA and Isolation Forest, while logistic regression reports higher F1. EWMA reports higher recall. Trade-offs are preserved.
limitations: No denominator or definition for reported FP rate
No record inclusion list or split
No scored windows or patient mapping

studies.title: 39-record exploratory ECG summary
studies.source: Historical Atlas ECG summary, Research/validation/ecg_v1/README.md and reference_summary.json
studies.interpretation: Preliminary record-level averages. Does not establish useful event forecasting or clinical performance.
limitations: 39 of 48 records processed but only six server-error exclusions described, three exclusions unresolved
Original scored windows and patient mapping not recovered
Event-matching rules and false alarms per hour unresolved
Reported mean lead interval is not validated event-matched predictive warning

public_safety: Contains aggregate outputs only, no protected operators, equations, thresholds, patient identifiers or synthetic curves.
